plugins.name: Wallhaven
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Browse wallhaven.cc and set your wallpaper from the desktop.
plugins.description: A wallpaper browser for the Ryoku desktop. Search wallhaven.cc, filter by latest or top, match your screen's aspect, page through results, and set any wallpaper with a click - all from a draggable tile that sits on your wallpaper alongside the clock and weather.

plugins.name: Photo Frame
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Pin a photo to your desktop, framed the way you like it.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that pins any photo to your wallpaper in a chosen frame style - rounded, square, polaroid, framed, or film - with a tunable drop shadow and live colour filters (mono, noir, sepia, warm, cool, vivid, fade). Drag, resize, and place it alongside your clock and weather; it ships with a sample photo so it looks right the moment you enable it.

plugins.name: Media
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Now-playing on your desktop, in seven faces.
plugins.description: A now-playing widget for the Ryoku desktop. Reads your active player and renders it as one of seven selectable faces - dossier, minimal, poster, spinning vinyl, cassette, a looping-GIF backdrop, or a live CAVA spectrum - each customizable and drawn in the shell's own style. Drag it onto your wallpaper beside the clock and weather.
